cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 add professional claims but A3 simply repeats Friday; no distinctive qualified method causes the explanation request.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 price justification leads to A3 insistence; B4 moved-after-invitations revelation causes A5 notification question, though the standard phrase adds nothing.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a signature and to leave for work; B4 admits a consequential change, providing genuine pressure.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 invitation timing consequential by asking when guests would learn the change.

specificity.evidence: A1 Friday-versus-Monday booking discrepancy gives immediate stakes without imagined documents needing extra explanation.

brevityWit.evidence: A1/A3 stock professional statements slow a tight sequence of booking, admission and notification.
